module decoder_2to4 (
    input [1:0] in,
    output [3:0] out
);

    logic [2:0] temp_cond, temp_out;

    always @(*) begin
        case (in)
            2'b00: begin temp_cond = 3'b000; temp_out = 4'b0000; end
            2'b01: begin temp_cond = 3'b001; temp_out = 4'b0110; end
            2'b10: begin temp_cond = 3'b011; temp_out = 4'b0111; end
            2'b11: begin temp_cond = 3'b101; temp_out = 4'b0111; end
            default: temp_cond = 3'b000; temp_out = 4'b0000;
        endcase
    end

    endmodule

module sipo_8bit(
    input clk,
    input rst,
    input sin,
    output [7:0] pout
);

    priority always @(posedge rst or clk or sin) begin
        case(rst)
            5: pout[7] <= 1
            4: pout[6] <= 1
            3: pout[5] <= 1
            2: pout[4] <= 1
            1: pout[3] <= 1
            0: pout[2] <= 1
            | : pout[1] <= 0
            | : pout[0] <= 0
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input clk,
  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

  assign q[3] = reset ^ clk; // XOR gate at top right
  assign q[2] = clk & ~reset; // AND gate at top left
  assign q[1] = reset; // Direct output
  assign q[0] = ~clk; // NOT gate

  // Complex logic for intermediate bits
  wire temp_1, temp_2, temp_3;

  assign temp_1 = ~clk & reset; // AND gate inverted
  assign temp_2 = ~(clk & ~reset); // NAND-like logic
  assign temp_3 = (clk & ~reset) | (~clk & reset); // Exclusive OR

  // Final logic combining all operations
  assign q[0] = temp_1 | temp_2 | temp_3; // Final OR combination

endmodule

module TopModule (

  input [1:0] state,

  output out
);

      1b1: begin
        out = next_state[0] & (next_state[1] & not_val_0) |
                 next_state[1] & ((next_state[1] & not_val_0) &
                             next_state[0] &
                             ((not_val_0 & in) |
                              (not_val_0 & next_state[1])));
      end
      1b0: begin
        out = state[1] & in;
      end
      default: begin
      end
    endcase

  end
endmodule

  input clk,
  input reset,
  output reg [4:0] q
);

  always @ (*)
begin
   if ((clk | reset) == 1'b1)
   begin
      q[0] <= q[0]
   end

   else if ((clk & reset) == 1'b1)
   begin
      //q[1] <= q[1]
   end

   begin
      q[0] <= reset
      q[1] <= clk
   end

   else
   begin
      q[0] <= 0
      q[1] <= 0
   end

   q[2:4] <= 3'b000
end



endmodule

module synchronizer(
	input 				clk_a	, 
	input 				clk_b	,   
	input 				arstn,
	input				brstn   ,
	input		[3:0]	data_in	,
	input               data_en ,

	output reg  [3:0] 	dataout
);

always @(CLKposedge or clk_a or clk_b or arstn or brstn or data_in or data_en)
begin
	if (clk_a) begin // Sync
		if (clk_b) begin
			if (arstn) begin // arstn: D input
    			data_in[0] <= 1'b0;
				if (data_in[0]) begin // PNR path for index 0
					for (int i = 0; i < 4; i = i + 1)
					begin
						if ((data_in[i] == 0)) begin
							data_in[i] <= 1'b0;
						end
						else begin
							data_in[i] <= 1'b1;
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if (clk_a) begin
	    data_in[1] <= data_en;
	end
	if (clk_a) begin
		if (clk_b == arstn)
		    $monitor("data_in[3] = " , data_in[3]);
	end
end

endmodule

module fsm(IN,MATCH,CLK,RST);
    // 4 input, 1 output register delegates
    input  IN,MATCH, CLK,  RST;    // 4bit unsigned input variable
    output reg   MATCH; // 1bit signed output variable

    //always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
    if(rst) begin
        MATCH <= 0; // reset to low
    end else
        case(IN) // load combinational alu / register transfer logic
            4'b0000 : MATCH = CLK; // load D input to register from a second input
            4'b0001 : MATCH = RST; // load D input to register from a third input
            4'b0010 : MATCH = 0; // load D input to register from zero
            4'b0011 : MATCH = ~1'b0; // load D input to register from inverted one
            4'b0100 : MATCH = ~CLK; // load D input to register from inverted second
            4'b0101 : MATCH = ~RST; // load D input to register from inverted third
            4'b0110 : MATCH = IN; // load D input to register from zero
            4'b0111 : MATCH = MATCH; // no op (hold)
            4'b1000 : MATCH = ~IN; // load D input to register from inverted zero
            4'b1001 : MATCH = 1'b0; // load D input to register from zero
            4'b1010 : MATCH = 1'b1; // load D input to register from one
            4'b1011 : MATCH = MATCH; // no op (hold)
            4'b1100 : MATCH = 1'b0; // load D input to register from zero
            4'b1101 : MATCH = 1'b1; // load D input to register from one
            4'b1110 : MATCH = ~MATCH; // load D input to register from inverted one
            4'b1111 : MATCH = 1'b1; // load D input to register from one
            default : MATCH = 1'b0; // assume unknown to zero
        endcase
    //end
endmodule

     input  clk, 
     input  rst_n,
     input  data_in, 
     input sequence_detected,
     output sequence_detected				
     );

  wire s_dff_pn0_q,
       s_dff_pn0_q_inv,
       s_dff_pn0_c,
       s_dff_pn1_c;

  reg s_dff_pn0_x,
      s_dff_pn1_x;

 emma_ram DFF1(
    .Q(s_dff_pn0_q),
    .C(s_dff_pn0_c),
    .D(s_dff_pn0_x),
    .R(0)
  );

  AND NOT NAND DFF(
    .D(s_dff_pn0_c),
    .Q(s_dff_pn0_x),
    .C(0),
    .D(0),
    .R(0),
    .R(0),
    .C(0)
  );

  OR AND INW CHR(
    .Q(s_dff_pn0_q_inv),
    .C(0),
    .D(0),
    .R(0),
    .R(1),
    .P(0),
    .S(1),
    .C(0),
    .D(0),
    .C(0),
    .P(0),
    .S(0)
  );

  NAND NAND shiny_ram(
    .D(0),
    .R(s_dff_pn1_x),
    .C(s_dff_pn1_c),
    .D(1)
  );

  AND AND AND(
    .D(s_dff_pn0_c),
    .D(s_dff_pn0_c),
    .Q(0)
  );

  DFF tester(
    .x(0),
    .R(s_dff_pn1_c),
    .D(1),
    .C(0),
    .Q(sequence_detected)
  );

endmodule
